name: value-utilities/shadow-ring
description: Shadow + ring families. Both compose through the shared `box-shadow` chain (`var(--tw-ring-offset-shadow, ..) , var(--tw-ring-shadow, ..) , var(--tw-shadow, ..)`). `shadow-<size>` writes both `--tw-shadow` (raw) and `--tw-shadow-colored` (with each embedded color literal replaced by `var(--tw-shadow-color)`) so a sibling `shadow-<color>` utility can override the color without changing geometry — direct port of upstream's `boxShadow` plugin driven by `parseBoxShadowValue` + `formatBoxShadowValue`. `ring` writes the `--tw-ring-offset-shadow` + `--tw-ring-shadow` cascade vars and the composed `box-shadow`; `ring-<color>` writes `--tw-ring-color` with the standard alpha-variable wrapping; `ring-inset` is a static toggle; `ring-offset-<width>` and `ring-offset-<color>` set the matching cascade vars without alpha-variable indirection.
